sentences.span: Because Alphabet, Amazon, and Meta can no longer fund this capital spending solely out cash generated from operations, they've issued debt
sentences.why: Directly supports the cash-flow-to-debt funding shift; the yield/hurdle framing is a reasonable analytical extension of the source's financing-cost concern, not a distortion of any figure or attribution.

sentences.span: Bonds were monkeyhammered (10Y near 5%), equities spent three days reconsidering their life choices
sentences.why: Last week's AI/tech-complex selloff being bond-driven rather than earnings-driven is well supported; the 'this morning' concentration claim is an unverifiable live-market extension, flagged accordingly.

sentences.span: We reiterate our Buy rating and 12-month price target of $725... Rating since Sep 12, 2021
sentences.why: The bank is Goldman Sachs, not JPMorgan; the target is $725, not $820; and the rating has stood since 2021, so this is a reiteration, not an upgrade — attribution, figure, and status are all changed.

sentences.span: Absent a surprise deal from MSFT... it is difficult to see supply as a driver of credit underperformance
sentences.why: The source's own credit desk view is the opposite of an active 'selling that strength into supply' stance; client flow that week was mixed buy/sell by maturity, not a clean directional sell described by the sentence.

sentences.span: 'Two chokepoints, One bigger crisis' as the Iran war moved from being a 'transitory risk
sentences.why: Directly matches the two-chokepoint (Hormuz plus Bab el-Mandeb) framing used to explain why this escalation has stuck rather than faded.

No source document contains a 91% (or 45%, end-of-August) trend-following/CTA long-Brent positioning statistic, nor a Goldman statement framing Iran as a low-probability, high-damage case where calm would move prices most; exhaustive search of commodity, positioning, and Iran-related files turned up nothing matching.

sentences.span: The Iran–Gulf meeting in Oman has also been postponed. There is no obvious off-ramp.
sentences.why: The postponement itself is supported, but 'Gulf states called it off on Sunday after a new Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia' adds an actor, a day, and a specific causal trigger not stated in any source; a same-day Bear Traps note (16176) instead describes the Oman meeting as still scheduled for Monday, conflicting with a settled 'called off' framing.

sentences.span: We suspect that the FOMC will want to nudge the market away from pricing an October hike too confidently but will not do it in the statement
sentences.why: Matches the framing that the hike itself is fully priced/settled and the live debate is about forward guidance into the following months.

sentences.span: Core CPI rose by 0.29% in August, a touch above expectations and up from 0.22% in July
sentences.why: Figures and Deutsche Bank attribution match exactly; the Wednesday quarter-point hike being close to fully priced is corroborated by the same file's 87% market pricing figure.

sentences.span: We do not see a strong economic case for raising the funds rate... We expect the FOMC to make only the minimum necessary change to its statement
sentences.why: Goldman's forecast (expects the hike, sees no strong economic case, expects the Fed to avoid extra guidance) matches; 'the dissent that matters is Goldman's' is a rhetorical label for the bank's contrarian house view, not a false claim that Goldman cast an FOMC vote.

10-year approaching/testing 5% ahead of the Wednesday FOMC is well grounded; framing it as a question of which side 'wins' by Wednesday is a fair characterization of the live tension described across sources.

sentences.span: nearly 5% of Russell 3000 stocks made a 52-week low even as the index itself remained less than 3% from a 52-week high
sentences.why: Matches almost verbatim, corroborated in two other files (16177, 16212).

sentences.span: global equity markets broke short term trendlines this week, and created marginal forced selling
sentences.why: Goldman's note describes a general 'global equity markets' trendline break, not specifically the S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, and Russell 2000 all breaking trigger levels simultaneously; no source names those three indices together in this context, and the QQQ/SPY intraday split is an unverifiable live figure layered on top.

sentences.span: IGV is +37% off the April lows... Mike expects momentum to rebuild with Software, Financial Services, Insurance and Healthcare Services prominent
sentences.why: The +37% figure belongs to IGV (software ETF) per Morgan Stanley, not to $VFLO or Bank of America as claimed; and Morgan Stanley's actual rotation call keeps Software 'prominent' rather than describing money leaving technology, contradicting the sentence's broadening-away-from-tech framing.

sentences.span: record SaaS buying in 2H August was still mostly short covering rather than real demand stepping in
sentences.why: The closest matching theme (crowded software shorts getting covered) is Morgan Stanley's, not Goldman's; no source anywhere uses 'flow desk' or ties this specifically to cybersecurity being bought into crowded shorts under a Goldman attribution.
